scripts.format: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt cli.ts modules scripts dependency-cruiser.config.cjs package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .github
scripts.format:check: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt --check cli.ts modules scripts dependency-cruiser.config.cjs package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .github
scripts.lint: bunx --bun --no-install oxlint --deny-warnings cli.ts modules scripts dependency-cruiser.config.cjs
scripts.lint:modules: bun scripts/check-module-shape.ts && bunx --bun --no-install depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs cli.ts modules scripts
scripts.quality: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:modules && bun run test:module-boundaries && bun run test
